test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_review_rotated_{n} (id UInt64,p Polygon) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_review_rotated_{n} WITH [(0.,0.),(0.,8.),(3. * {n} + 4,8.),(3. * {n} + 4,0.)] AS exterior, arrayRotateLeft(exterior, toInt64(number % 4)) AS shifted SELECT number, [arrayPushBack(shifted,shifted[1]), [(3. * number + 1,1.),(3. * number + 2,1.),(3. * number + 2,2.),(3. * number + 1,2.),(3. * number + 1,1.)]] FROM numbers({n})
test.query: SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(p) FROM bench_review_rotated_{n} FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonIntersectionMerge(s) FROM (SELECT groupPolygonIntersectionState(p) AS s FROM bench_review_rotated_{n} GROUP BY intDiv(id,32)) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1

test.query: SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(p) FROM bench_review_rotated_reverse_{n} FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1

test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_review_overlap_holes_{n} (id UInt64,p Polygon) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_review_overlap_holes_{n} SELECT number, [[(0.,0.),(0.,8.),(toFloat64({n}) + 5,8.),(toFloat64({n}) + 5,0.),(0.,0.)],[(number + 1.,1. + number % 2),(number + 3.,1. + number % 2),(number + 3.,4. + number % 2),(number + 1.,4. + number % 2),(number + 1.,1. + number % 2)]] FROM numbers({n})
test.query: SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(p) FROM bench_review_overlap_holes_{n} FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1

test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_review_controlled_groups_{n} (g UInt64,p Polygon) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_review_controlled_groups_{n} WITH toFloat64(intDiv(number,64)) AS x SELECT number % 64,[[(x,0.),(x,2.),(x+2,2.),(x+2,0.),(x,0.)]] FROM numbers(64 * {n})
test.query: SELECT g, groupPolygonUnion(p) FROM bench_review_controlled_groups_{n} GROUP BY g FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1

test.query: SELECT groupPolygonUnion(p) FROM bench_review_corner_{n} FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
